Tasks without a recorded spawn are left out. - p90 spawn to merge i 90th percentile (nearest rank) of the same times: nine in ten tasks merged faster. - Agents running now i Agents with a live pane right now: workers, team leads and HQ (boss, director, staff engineer). 2 2 workers · 0 leads · 0 HQ Unattended share i Merged tasks in the selected period with no owner involvement: no owner wait, no auto-merge block, no boss decision about the task. 2 of 2 Cost per merged PR i Average estimated API-equivalent cost of a merged PR at list prices as of 2026-10-25: the whole cost of each merged Claude-org task in the period (not cut to the period), divided by the tasks with a known cost. Tasks with no attributed tokens or no price are left out and counted. Cursor reports no tokens, so it has no cost. - Cursor: 2.5 agent-hours in 14 days, no cost or tokens reported. Counted from factory records only. It cannot see a push the owner makes by hand, or an owner wait set on a task that was already blocked.
